loop_primitives.evidence_quote: We create a ReAct agent (Yao et al., 2022) and give it access to the knowledge base.
loop_primitives.note: Each turn follows a fixed pipeline: CSP, then KP, then runtime policy, then response generator. The knowledge parser is ReAct.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the policy identifies the first unfilled field in the dia- logue state and generates an agent act requesting the user to provide the missing values.

multi_agent_topology.note: The pipeline consists of separate LLM components (parser, knowledge parser, response generator), not autonomous agents. The system could arguably be coded as single.
